# BookmarkState stages edits and consumes batch results during save

Each section is a checked body contract at Firefox revision `1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b`. These records describe source behavior. They do not promote source patterns into coding policy.

## BookmarkState.constructor

Evidence: [BookmarkState.constructor:61-93](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/PlacesUIUtils.sys.mjs#L61-L93).

Trigger: gEditItemOverlay.makeNewStateObject initializes an item.

Captures GUID, postData, tag-container flag, bulk URLs, folder/children/autosave options. Builds original title/URI/normalized nonempty tags/keyword/parent/index and an empty edited-state object.

Result and completion: Returns editing state. Original and pending values are separate until save.

Errors: No separate error handling in this body; caller receives thrown errors or promise rejection.

Ownership and cleanup: Editing overlay retains state until uninit. Accepted dialog passes it to opener before overlay clears its reference.

Checked callers and consumers: [gEditItemOverlay.makeNewStateObject:687-714](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/content/editBookmark.js#L687-L714).

## BookmarkState._createBookmark

Evidence: [BookmarkState._createBookmark:164-189](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/PlacesUIUtils.sys.mjs#L164-L189).

Trigger: save sees an unsaved nonfolder item.

Builds NewBookmark from chosen parent, new/original title/URI and original index. Passes only _newState.tags. If new keyword is truthy, adds a dependent EditKeyword using first batch GUID. Awaits batch and takes results[0] as _guid.

Result and completion: Resolves stored GUID, which can be undefined if first batch member failed. Opener and later saves consume it.

Errors: batch catches member errors and returns undefined slots; this body does not separately check success. Construction or queue failure can reject.

Ownership and cleanup: Uses the enclosing module or object state; this body does not release that owner.

Unresolved: Creation failure handling and repeated saves after a failed first result were not run.

## BookmarkState._createFolder

Evidence: [BookmarkState._createFolder:196-222](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/PlacesUIUtils.sys.mjs#L196-L222).

Trigger: save sees an unsaved folder item.

Builds NewFolder with title/children/index. Adds bulk tagging transactions when bulk URLs exist. Awaits batch and stores first result as folder GUID. NewFolder ignores undeclared tags input; bulk tagging is the explicit tag path.

Result and completion: Resolves folder GUID. Batch failure can leave an undefined first result.

Errors: No separate error handling in this body; caller receives thrown errors or promise rejection.

Ownership and cleanup: Uses the enclosing module or object state; this body does not release that owner.

## BookmarkState.save

Evidence: [BookmarkState.save:233-310](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/PlacesUIUtils.sys.mjs#L233-L310).

Trigger: Accepted dialog opener or autosave setter persists state.

Unsaved item delegates to creation. No edited keys returns current GUID. Tag container with new title transacts RenameTag and catch-logs failure, then returns GUID. Other items apply URI first, then title/tags/keyword/parent transactions in pending-key order. Await batch if nonempty, then merge all pending state into baseline and clear pending state.

Result and completion: Resolves GUID. Batch member failure is logged/undefined by batch, so resolution/baseline update is not proof every requested field persisted.

Errors: Tag rename rejection is logged/swallowed. Constructors or queue failure can reject. Batch member failures do not prevent baseline merge.

Ownership and cleanup: Existing-item save drops _newState after merge; raw transactions/history retain their own undo data.

Test links:

- **direct**: [test_bookmark_properties_dialog_on_folder:56-76](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/tests/browser/browser_bookmarkProperties_editFolder.js#L56-L76). Checks accepted title reaches the selected tree node.
- **direct**: [editTagContainer:94-140](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/tests/browser/browser_bookmarkProperties_editTagContainer.js#L94-L140). Checks accepted tag rename reaches tagging state.
- **direct**: [test_cancel_with_changes:86-126](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/tests/browser/browser_bookmarkProperties_cancel.js#L86-L126). Checks canceled staged title leaves stored title unchanged.

Unresolved: Autosave overlap and partial batch failure baseline consistency were not exercised.

## BookmarkState._appendTagsTransactions

Evidence: [BookmarkState._appendTagsTransactions:326-350](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/blob/1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b/browser/components/places/PlacesUIUtils.sys.mjs#L326-L350).

Trigger: Folder creation or existing save compares pending tags to original tags.

Computes added and removed tag sets by includes. Adds Tag transaction for additions and Untag transaction for removals; empty differences add nothing.

Result and completion: Mutates caller transaction array. It does not execute storage work itself.

Errors: No separate error handling in this body; caller receives thrown errors or promise rejection.
